subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: Undoubtedly, wildlife plays a vital role in the nature. (a) -----, it goes without saying (b) ----- wildlife is the part and parcel of our environment. (c) ----- man and other domestic animals, the rest of the animals live in the forest. The animals living in the forest are called wild animals (d) ----- the manner of their living is known (e) ----- wildlife.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) So; (b) that; (c) Except; (d) because; (e) as.
